 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No. 91/2022 registered at Police Station Nagalwadi District Bawani (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.

2. Learned counsel for applicant seeks permission to withdraw the M.Cr.C.
3.
4. M.Cr.C. is accordingly dismissed as withdrawn.
